title: Accessibility
scenario: The W8.1 scene (status label, named text field, named slider) with a Splitter and a hidden 64 Ki-unit multiline document, 640x480 offscreen EmbeddedHost with UI Automation attached, reduced motion. 100 mutations with no client and 100 with one; 100 Slider steps, a 200 px Splitter drag and a 64-step word walk with one. A client is the client gate's test override, so counters never depend on event arrival. Proves G9 and the W8 gates.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: the first frame; accessibility attaches with no client and the root provider is taken; the slider takes logical focus

phases.name: mutations-no-client
phases.description: no client: publish the previous frame, then mutation i of the W8.1 scene

phases.name: mutations-one-client
phases.description: one client: publish the previous frame, then mutation i of the W8.1 scene

phases.name: slider-one-client
phases.description: one client: publish, then one Right key on the focused slider (one step)

phases.name: splitter-one-client
phases.description: one client: publish, then the Splitter drag: pointer down on the separator, 200 moves of 1 px, pointer up

phases.name: wordwalk-one-client
phases.description: one client: step 0 shows the 64 Ki-unit document; each later step moves the text range 1,000 characters on, then one word step: Move by one word, ExpandToEnclosingUnit(Word) and GetText, through the text range provider in-process
